channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 18 November
item.description: The network plan was revised and test items were recorded, while documentation of phase execution was added. Pagination handling was corrected and documentation trimmed, and a new evidence matrix and related test scenarios were added to the blockchain component. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 17 November
item.description: A pattern map and research phases were added to the network, with documentation updates, and durability checks plus test work were introduced to the blockchain component. User list overrides, identity seeds, and role support were added to the SDK, and third‑party resolution was updated in the miscellaneous component. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, cmaketemplate, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 16 November
item.description: The network summary and plans were fixed and updated, and storage backup notes were rewritten. Merge fixes and additional test work were applied to the blockchain component. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 15 November
item.description: Diagnostic prints were added and then enhanced in the wallet verification module. Repositories: GeniusWallet.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 14 November
item.description: A roadmap and requirement list were documented for the upcoming milestone, and the backup model for storage was updated. Repositories: GeniusNetwork.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: The cognitive system removed the GQHSM submodule and updated related documentation, while the network upgraded its backup handling and logged a storage gap; cold‑storage retention was improved in the blockchain component. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GNUS-NEO-SWARM.
